n: 600 Series Electric Stacked Laundry Tower - 4.5 Cu. Ft. Washer & 8.0 Cu. Ft. Dryer
desc: The full-size and fully integrated front-load electric Electrolux Laundry Tower™ features a stacked design that takes up half the floor space, freeing up the laundry room for extra storage. It also has an easy-to-reach control panel.
hl: Vertical stacked design that gives you back space
Fully integrated vertical layout takes up half the floor space of a traditional washer/dryer for greater laundry room flexibility, or to fit easily into most closets and other tight spaces.
Just 30 minutes for a wash and dry--quickly deep cleans and dries the items you need most.
Easily clean large loads and even a king-sized comforter with extra large capacity (4.5 cu. ft. in the washer and 8.0 cu. Ft. in the dryer).
Instant Refresh cycle revives fabrics without washing
Save water and energy with the Instant Refresh dryer cycle, which removes wrinkles and refreshes items from light wear in 10 minutes, without having to do a full wash
Remove bacteria with the Sanitize washer setting
Certified to kill and remove 99% of bacteria.
Remove allergens with our Allergen option
Remove 95% of allergens from your clothing, towels and bedding with our NSF®-certified Allergen option
